description: This file contains implementation of a spinlock class used for synchronization, including lock acquisition, release, profiling, and internal state management.

classes.name: SpinLock
classes.description: A class implementing a spinlock mechanism with profiling and contention tracking.

methods.name: RegisterSpinLockProfiler
methods.description: Registers a profiling callback for spinlock contention data.

methods.name: SpinLoop
methods.description: Monitors the lock state in a loop to detect contention.

methods.name: SlowLock
methods.description: Handles the slow path of acquiring the lock, including waiting and contention management.

methods.name: SlowUnlock
methods.description: Handles unlocking and profiling of contention wait times.

methods.name: EncodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Encodes wait duration into a compact form for storage in the lock word.

methods.name: DecodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Decodes the stored wait duration from the lock word.
